title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards Terms: Validity Periods and Unclaimed Balances
content:
These terms govern how long the value on each kind of Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards can be used.

1. **Whether value expires.** The value of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, a Marlowe & Finch eGift Card, a Merchandise Credit Card and a Corporate Gift Card does not expire. The value of a Registry Reward Card and of a Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card expires.
2. **Validity period.** For a kind whose value expires, the validity period is the number of calendar days, counting the day of activation as day 1, through which the card can be used: 365 calendar days for a Registry Reward Card and 45 calendar days for a Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card. For kinds whose value does not expire, no validity period applies.
3. **First day of use of a promotional card.** A Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card cannot be redeemed until 14 calendar days after its issue. No such waiting period applies to any other kind.
4. **Unclaimed property.** For every kind, the unclaimed-property position is the same: unused balances are not reported as unclaimed property — no expiry, balance held indefinitely.

## Schedule

| Card kind | Value expires | Validity period (calendar days, activation day is day 1) | Days after issue before first redemption | Unclaimed-property reporting |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not reported; no expiry, balance held indefinitely |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not reported; no expiry, balance held indefinitely |
| Merchandise Credit Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not reported; no expiry, balance held indefinitely |
| Registry Reward Card | Yes | 365 | Not applicable | Not reported; no expiry, balance held indefinitely |
| Corporate Gift Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not reported; no expiry, balance held indefinitely |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | Yes | 45 | 14 | Not reported; no expiry, balance held indefinitely |

## Counting the validity period (hypothetical dates)

Day 1 is the day of activation, so the last usable day is the activation day plus the validity period less one day.

- A hypothetical Registry Reward Card activated on 10 January: day 1 is 10 January and day 365 is the last usable day; in a year of 365 days that is 9 January of the following year.
- A hypothetical Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card activated on 1 March: day 1 is 1 March and day 45 is 14 April. Its first redeemable day, 14 calendar days after an issue on 1 March, is 15 March.
